decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a high-quality, reliable portable speaker for outdoor use. My consideration set focuses on well-known brands like JBL and Altec Lansing, as well as high-rated alternatives like Comiso. The JBL Clip 3 and Go 3 are excellent for portability, but I'm concerned they won't provide enough volume for a larger outdoor gathering. The JBL Charge 4 is the ideal size and power level, but at $89.95, I am hesitant to buy a 'Renewed' unit rather than a brand-new one with a full warranty. The Comiso 30W speaker offers the power I want at a good price, but the 'Dead on Arrival' reviews make me wary of its long-term durability. Given that I'm specifically looking for a new, mid-sized speaker with high-fidelity sound, none of the options currently in stock perfectly meet my criteria at the right price point.
